description:
Offline emergency preparedness inventory manager with barcode scanning
Prepper is an offline emergency preparedness inventory manager. Track your supplies, containers, and storage locations using barcode scanning. All data is stored locally on your device with no cloud dependencies.

Features:
- Barcode/QR code scanning for locations, containers, and supplies
- Hierarchical container organization with arbitrary nesting
- Supply tracking with expiration dates and shelf life management
- Support for both metric and imperial units
- Database backup and restore
